digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit workflow documentation and guidance
propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid when git credential helpers are configured.
AGENTS.md must document that authenticated Gerrit /a/ REST calls should use git credential fill when credentials are stored in a Git helper, not curl --netrc.
The shell pattern for Gerrit REST credential passing must prevent echoing or logging passwords while preserving existing git push and gate guidance.
tests/unit/test_codex_agent_guidance.py must assert correct usage of git credential fill, curl --netrc conditional behavior, 401 false-positive explanation, and password no-echo requirement.
